# Bio

Fourth-year Economics PhD student at Florida State University.

My research is in public economics, labor economics, and the economics of education. Current projects
examine how teacher incentive pay affects retention and mobility, the long-run effects of voluntary
prekindergarten, and how economic crises reshape the teacher labor market. I also work as a research
assistant to Shawn Kantor, studying the effects of pharmaceutical regulation
on scientific careers and knowledge production.

## Honors & Awards
